Scope of Supply. The successful bidder shall supply, install, configure, and commission desktop comp uter systems with the following minimum specifications. A. Desktop Computer Specifications Sl. No. Item Description Minimum Technical Specification 1 Processor Intel Core i5 Processor, 11th Gen or higher/AMD Ryzen5 2 Make OEM branded desktop (HP / Dell / Lenovo / Acer or equivalent) 3 Operating System Windows 11 Professional, preloaded and licensed 4 RAM Minimum 16 GB DDR4 expandable 5 Storage Minimum 500 GB SSD/500GB HD 6 Monitor 21.5” or higher Full HD LED Monitor 7 Graphics Integrated Graphics. 8 Keyboard USB Keyboard. 9 Mouse USB Optical Mouse 10 Network Integrated Gigabit Ethernet 11 Ports Minimum 4 USB ports, HDMI/VGA 12 Audio Integrated Audio 13 Power Supply Standard OEM Supply with Energy Efficient Rating 14 Warranty Minimum 3 Years Onsite OEM Warranty 2. Scope of Services The bidder shall: 1. Supply the desktop computers and accessories as per specifications. 2. Deliver the items at the consignee location. 3. Install and configure all systems. 4. Activate and verify licensed Windows 11 Pro OS. 5. Ensure all systems are tested and operational before handover. 6. Provide warranty support during the warranty period. 7. Replace defective components without additional cost during warranty. 3.
